overall_reason: Every role (heading, labels, link and the primary button) is drawn in one band of pale cool grey (#a4adb3, #aeb7bd, a #c6cfd5 button with #eef1f3 text) on a near-identical #e7ebed panel, so there is no ink and no accent.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES finds no ink role and T-GRAYSCALE finds the primary action fading into the panel: colour works against reading.

findings.title: The palette converges to a few roles
findings.where: the whole share panel, 1440 and 375, tiles/1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The text roles list the heading 'Share document' and 2 small labels in #a4adb3 and one in #aeb7bd (OKLCH L about 0.73 to 0.77), on a panel #e7ebed (L about 0.93). The palette has 0 chromatic groups and 8 cool neutrals.
findings.before: Heading, body, metadata and button all in one pale grey band.
findings.after: A dark ink for the heading and labels, one secondary grey, and a filled primary action in ink or the product's accent.
findings.why: With no ink role, the reader cannot tell the title from metadata, and the panel reads as disabled.

findings.title: Never convey information by colour alone
findings.evidence: The button fill #c6cfd5 sits one small lightness step from the panel #e7ebed, and its label #eef1f3 is nearly the panel colour. In the grayscale fold the button reads as a disabled bar.
findings.before: A primary action in pale grey with near-white text.
findings.after: The primary action as the darkest element on the panel.

findings.title: Regions use the lowest rung of the surface ladder
findings.evidence: The panel and the ground around it are nearly the same grey; the area palette lists #e7ebed at 5.5% with no distinct second ground step.
findings.before: A box on a well of nearly the same tone.
findings.after: One surface, or a clear step between ground and panel.
findings.why: The surface step is too small to separate anything, so it adds an edge without a region.

not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
